about_the_game:
No one programs your destiny.

Fight, hack, and survive in a world overrun by hostile machines, where each incursion is a race against death. Lia: Hacking Destiny is a fast-paced action roguelite with intense combat and choices that shape your journey toward freedom.

⚔️ Dynamic Combat
Dodge attacks, slide along walls, and combine weapons and abilities to crush enemies in adrenaline-filled battles.

🏗️ Procedurally Generated Maps
Each run is unique. Security complexes change every time, with procedurally generated rooms, traps, and enemies. Learn, adapt, and push further.

🤖 Constant Evolution
Upgrade your weapons, unlock abilities, modify equipment, and personalize your playstyle. From aggressive builds to tactical strategies—the power is in your hands.

🧠 Hack the System
Use technology to your advantage. Modify alert levels to access secret rooms and uncover hidden secrets behind walls of concrete and steel.

👥 Find Allies, Build Your Base
Meet other survivors between missions. Build stations, improve resources, and unlock new possibilities. Your camp evolves with you—and might be the key to changing everything.

🎮 Key Features

  • Fluid combat with responsive controls

  • Roguelite systems with ever-changing maps

  • Customizable skills and weapons

  • Base with NPCs and permanent upgrades

  • Vibrant visual style with a post-apocalyptic atmosphere

short_description: Dive, fight, and hack your way through deadly facilities in Lia: Hacking Destiny. A fast-paced roguelite where every room is a challenge, every choice matters, and every step brings you closer to freedom. Dodge, destroy, evolve — and prove no one can rewrite your destiny but you.
